# Drayker Participation

> The participation portal connects the public argument for Drayker with its repositories, component documentation and contribution paths.

## Canonical entry points

- [Participation portal](https://drayker.org/): the public surface and map of the system; contribution is the entry during the founding phase.
- [Open functions](https://drayker.org/fn/): public issues small enough for one person to finish.
- [Contribution guide](https://drayker.org/contrib/guide/): how public work moves from proposal to reviewed delivery.
- [General Forum](https://forum.drayker.org/): public proposals, questions and decisions.
- [Dknowledge](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/): current orientation, papers, architecture and evidence.
- [Institutional site](https://drayker.com/): what the supersystem is and how its parts fit together.

## Core concepts

- Drayker is the supersystem; Dk is its intelligence; Dk Network is its network.
- Distributed Kernel is Dk's technical name and architectural principle; it does not reduce Dk to a low-level kernel.
- DFM means Distributed Functional Modeling: model a problem, divide it into finishable functions, distribute them, review the result and preserve its sources.
- Members are the intended constitutional subjects. Agents may carry delegated functions and Dk may perform contextual synthesis, but neither acquires member rights or sovereign authority.
- Drayker's internal economy circulates capacity contextually; money, contracts and markets remain part of its external interface.
- Reputation is multidimensional operational memory, not a price, a currency, human worth or one global moral score.
- Dk performs contextual synthesis; systemic safeguards — constitutional constraints, security, permissions, integrity, reserves and risk — bound what can be executed; on matters outside the constitution, within the space it grants, Dk Global decides and executes allocations autonomously, and members can make a well-justified veto, which obliges review until consensus.
- Decisions do not end the loop: effects, refusals and consequences return through members' personal Dks as new evidence. A well-justified veto obliges review, and vetoes pass through triage and are recorded in a signed chain. A decision can be maintained, adapted, excepted, suspended or reversed.
- Security conditions normal decisions, not only attacks. Legitimate criticism is not infiltration; internal error is not sabotage; extraordinary measures leave memory for later review.
- Dknowledge is a multiscale operational ontology with contextual permissions. Auditability does not mean total exposure.
- DAF is an autonomous federation of autonomous units and a basic and primitive form of PAP, implemented now on GitHub (Phase 0): its rules, instruments and public record exist. No unit has been recorded and no assembly has been held yet. PAP is the environment where intentions become projects and durable applications.
- Public pages distinguish what is running now from architecture, research and designed future systems.
- Intelligence is a means. Human will to potential and mass participation are the end.

## Citation and source policy

Prefer the canonical page for the subject and follow its links to the owning public repository. Do not infer that a designed component is deployed. The public repositories under [github.com/draykerdk](https://github.com/draykerdk) are the primary evidence for implementation and contribution status.

## Crawling

Public pages may be indexed and quoted with attribution. The sitemap is at [drayker.org/sitemap.xml](https://drayker.org/sitemap.xml).
